articles.summary: The platform is currently unavailable for most users. We're investigating
articles.title: Platform unavailable

articles.summary: Langdock for Excel and Langdock for Outlook are currently unavailable for new installations. Existing installations continue to work as expected. The issue also appears to affect other plugins in the Microsoft Marketplace. We’re investigating the issue and monitoring Microsoft’s status page for updates: https://status.cloud.microsoft/m365
articles.title: Excel & Outlook plugins can't be installed

articles.summary: We're performing planned maintenance to upgrade our database version and improve reliability. The maintenance will take place within a 30-minute maintenance window, and Langdock is expected to be unavailable for approximately 15 minutes. We've reserved the additional time to allow sufficient time for the upgrade and verification. We've scheduled this during off-peak hours to minimize disruption. Thank you for your patience! The Langdock Team
articles.title: Scheduled Maintenance: Database Upgrade

articles.summary: Some Claude models provided by Langdock are currently unavailable. Chat requests will fall back to another model. We have identified the root cause and are actively working on resolving it.
articles.title: Some Claude models unavailable

articles.summary: All requests to Anthropic models hosted on GCP return the error "Forbidden" right now. We are investigating the incident actively and are working on a resolution.
articles.title: Anthropic models receive "Forbidden" Errors
